## How a clip moves

```
SILENT --(you hear it in the browser, know it never plays)--> WIP
WIP    --(a mod fires it in-game, verified live)-----------> DONE
```

Move clips with `voice_browser.py` (Move -> / <- Move, or the arrow keys).
Every move writes `progress.json` and regenerates this file.
